display.purpose: Hero headlines and major dashboard metrics.

shadows.name: floating-element
shadows.purpose: Used for dropdowns, popovers, and dialogs to lift them above the flat surface.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0066cc; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-weight: 500; font-family: sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #004d99; }

components.name: Card Container
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; padding: 24px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #d1d1d1; font-family: sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin-top: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Professional, efficient, and crystal clear. Avoids unnecessary decoration to focus on speed and clarity. This system serves operations, support, and finance staff who spend their entire day in the dashboard. It explicitly rejects sketchy SVGs, playful themes, and cluttered interfaces, prioritizing cognitive ease and accessibility.

Key Characteristics:
- High data density with clean separation.
- Unambiguous visual hierarchy.
- Restrained color application, reserving saturation for status and critical actions.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The primary accent is used on ≤10% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Depth is strictly reserved for transient, contextual overlays.

dos: Do use logical layout classes (start/end) instead of physical (left/right) to support RTL natively.
Do reserve the Trust Anchor Blue strictly for interactive elements and primary status indications.
Do format all dates and money using locale-aware formatters.
donts: Don't use sketchy SVGs, doodles, or playful themes.
Don't use floating point for money in any calculation; rely on API values and formatters.
Don't cache server data inside Zustand stores.
Don't construct identical card grids that repeat heavily without structural variation.
